_comment: required=false and defaultRequire=0 are the load-bearing pair of this file: every
injection in com.aetherium.mixin.core additionally carries require=0/expect=0, so a
rename in a new Minecraft version degrades one feature instead of refusing to launch.
advanced.strict_mixins=true flips required to true at runtime through
No maxShiftBy is needed: no injection shifts past an INVOKE, which is why a
rename inside a method body cannot make an injection land in the wrong place.
The mixin list is client-only on purpose: a dedicated server has no renderer to hook.
